svg.title: urna setup: from an empty machine to the doctor checks
svg.desc: urna, end to end: urna setup on an empty machine (scan, plan, the offline embedder payload, the python env, the doctor checks), then urna tui: open a corpus, ask it, read the cited answer, check the install, quit. Steps: 1 · urna setup: the installer every channel ends in / 2 · scan: what the machine already has, read only / 3 · plan: every step, what it downloads and where it goes / 4 · install: the payload verified by sha256, the venv made by uv / 5 · verify: the doctor checks pass, offline
